stimulus.question: Checkout is reported to show elevated errors in the OTel Demo. Using the authorized metrics range query and trace search for the last 5 minutes, determine whether checkout and its dependency calls (payment, product-catalog, cart, currency, shipping, email) show failures or elevated latency, cite trace ids, and return a json investigation report.

claims.text: Sampled checkout spans show 12 oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder server spans in error between 18:11:54Z and 18:23:43Z, each with otel.status_code=ERROR, rpc.grpc.status_code=13 and otel.status_description 'failed to charge card: could not charge the card: rpc error: code = Unknown desc = Payment request failed. Invalid token. app.loyalty.level=gold' (checkout service_version 2.0.2).

Payment's own server spans (service payment, span grpc.oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge, service_version 2.0.2) carry error=true, otel.status_code=ERROR, grpc.error_message 'Payment request failed. Invalid token. app.loyalty.level=gold' and an exception stacktrace 'at module.exports.charge (/usr/src/app/charge.js:37:13)' / 'at async Object.chargeServiceHandler [as charge] (/usr/src/app/index.js:21:22)', i.e. the failure is thrown inside payment's charge code.

In the same payment trace sample, other Charge server spans completed normally (only rpc.grpc.status_code=0, no error tag) at 18:18:09Z, 18:18:56Z and 18:19:53Z, so payment was up and serving some charges successfully while others failed.

The checkout PlaceOrder error ratio (increase of status_code=STATUS_CODE_ERROR over all statuses, 300s window) was 0 at 18:10:00Z, 0.111 at 18:12:00Z, 0.5 at 18:14:00Z, 1.0 at 18:16:00Z and 18:18:00Z, then 0.571 at 18:20:00Z; no error ratio above 0 appears before 18:12:00Z in that series.

For the ten-minute windows ending 17:40Z through 18:09Z, checkout oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder STATUS_CODE_ERROR increase was 0; it turned non-zero only from the window ending 18:14Z (1.11) and climbed to 12.21-12.22 for the windows ending 18:18Z and 18:20Z, with payment grpc.oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge STATUS_CODE_ERROR showing identical values at every point.

Over the hour 17:24Z-18:24Z, the only non-zero checkout error series were oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder (11.18) and oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge (11.18), identical values; checkout's other error series returned 0 in the same query (oteldemo.CartService/EmptyCart, oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/GetProduct, oteldemo.CheckoutService/prepareOrderItems).

Payment span inventory in the window contains only 'charge', 'grpc.flagd.evaluation.v1.Service/ResolveFloat' and 'grpc.oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge'; the sample shows the flagd ResolveFloat span as a child of the Charge server span with rpc.grpc.status_code=0, so the flag-evaluation call itself did not error.

flagd's impression metric for feature_flag_key='paymentFailure' began returning result variant '100%': increase over 600s was 0 for every window ending 17:34Z, 17:39Z, 17:44Z, 17:49Z, 17:54Z, 17:59Z, 18:04Z and 18:09Z, then 2.22 for the window ending 18:14Z, 6.67 for 18:19Z and 5.56 for 18:24Z; the 'off' variant of the same flag also jumped from about 1-2 per 10 minutes in those earlier windows to 17.76/20.0/10.0.

Raw flagd series at 18:22Z-18:23Z show feature_flag_key='paymentFailure' with feature_flag_reason='STATIC' and two result variants in use: '100%' (counter 311) and 'off' (counter 506 rising to 513), on flagd pod flagd-d6485586b-vhr8v (service_version v0.12.8).

Frontend's own error spans rose with the checkout failures: in the window ending 18:20Z, service frontend shows STATUS_CODE_ERROR increase of 12.22 on 'POST', 12.22 on 'executing api route (pages) /api/checkout' and 12.22 on 'grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder', all 0 in the earlier windows ending 17:39Z-18:09Z.

Other services' error series in 18:14Z-18:24Z were either zero (cart POST /oteldemo.CartService/EmptyCart, checkout CartService/EmptyCart and ProductCatalogService/GetProduct, checkout prepareOrderItems, product-catalog oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/GetProduct, frontend /api/products/[productId] and /api/recommendations, frontend grpc.oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/GetProduct) or the small pre-existing ad/flagd stream errors (ad flagd EventStream 1.11, ad GetAds 1.11, frontend GET 1.11, /api/data 1.11, grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds 1.11).

The proximate cause of the alert is the flagd flag 'paymentFailure' resolving to result variant '100%' for the affected Charge calls (evaluated by payment over grpc.flagd.evaluation.v1.Service/ResolveFloat during Charge), which makes payment's chase code throw 'Payment request failed. Invalid token.' and fail checkout PlaceOrder. The variant '100%' first appears in the flagd impression data in the window ending 18:14Z, matching the first observed PlaceOrder errors, but the flag definition, its targeting rule and the reason the '100%' variant applies to exactly these requests are not visible in the integrated sources.

Alternative candidate still open: the 'Invalid token' rejection could come from payment's own card-token validation on the request payload independent of the flag (the error is raised in payment code, and every sampled error message additionally carries app.loyalty.level=gold). The evidence cannot distinguish this from flag-driven failure injection, because no trace field exposes which token or flag key/value drove the rejection.

Rejected: a failure of another checkout dependency (cart, product-catalog, prepareOrderItems path) causing the PlaceOrder errors. Checkout's own error spans for oteldemo.CartService/EmptyCart, oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/GetProduct and oteldemo.CheckoutService/prepareOrderItems were 0 over the hour, and PlaceOrder's error total is identical to the PaymentService/Charge client-span error total, not to any other dependency's.

Rejected: payment being unreachable/down. Payment server spans exist throughout the incident window, its gRPC status on successful Charge calls is 0, and checkout's Charge client span returns gRPC status 2 with an application-level 'Invalid token' description, i.e. the call reached payment and payment answered with an application error.

The ad/flagd EventStream and frontend GET error series (~1.11 per 10 minutes) are background noise, not part of this incident: they are present in the windows before the incident (ending 17:30Z, 17:40Z, 17:50Z) with the same magnitude and are not tied to PlaceOrder.

gaps: change_history and kubernetes_state integrations are not available, so a flagd configuration change (ConfigMap edit), restart or redeploy around 18:11Z cannot be confirmed, and flagd/payment pod readiness and deployment revisions are unknown.

The flagd flag definition for paymentFailure (its variant list, targeting rule and which request attribute selects variant '100%') is not exposed by any queried metric; the only visible request context is the literal text 'app.loyalty.level=gold' inside the error message, so why only part of the Charge traffic failed is unknown.

Absolute failure counts are unreliable: increase() readings of traces_span_metrics_calls_total disagree between 5-minute and 10-minute windows at 18:22Z-18:24Z (0 vs non-zero), and the whole-hour increase (11.18) is far smaller than the sum of the 10-minute windows, so the exact number or percentage of failed PlaceOrder requests cannot be stated.
Whether the paymentFailure='100%' resolution was intentional fault injection or an accidental configuration change is unknown.

Not checked or only partially checked: shipping, currency, email, accounting, fraud-detection, quote, recommendation and cart server-side error behaviour; kube-state metrics for payment/flagd; any alerting on flagd itself.
next_steps: Review the flagd flag configuration and its change history for feature_flag_key 'paymentFailure' (variant '100%', reason STATIC) around 2026-11-03T18:10Z, and determine whether the '100%' variant and any loyalty-level targeting rule were intended.
If the change is unintended, have the owner restore the previous paymentFailure value and re-check checkout PlaceOrder error ratio and payment Charge error spans.
Check flagd and payment pod/deployment state (namespace otel-demo, flagd pod flagd-d6485586b-vhr8v) in an integration that exposes Kubernetes state, since that data source was not integrated here.

Confirm with payment service owners whether 'Payment request failed. Invalid token.' can also be produced by card-token validation independent of the paymentFailure flag, to close the remaining alternative hypothesis.
report_parsed.summary: Checkout's PlaceOrder failures are caused by the payment service's own Charge handler rejecting calls with 'Payment request failed. Invalid token.' (thrown at /usr/src/app/charge.js:37). Every sampled checkout PlaceOrder error span between 18:11:54Z and 18:23:43Z carries exactly that payment error text, and checkout's PlaceOrder error-span total equals its PaymentService/Charge client-span error total exactly. Payment is not down: it keeps serving Charge calls with rpc.grpc.status_code 0 in the same interval. The strongest supported trigger is a flagd feature-flag change: the flagd impression metric for flag key paymentFailure began returning result variant '100%' at about 18:11-18:14Z (it was 0 for every window from 17:34Z to 18:04Z), and payment evaluates a float flag over gRPC (span grpc.flagd.evaluation.v1.Service/ResolveFloat) as part of Charge. The failure propagated to frontend, whose own POST and /api/checkout error spans rose in lockstep. Whether the flag change was an intentional fault injection or a misconfiguration cannot be verified with the integrated sources.
